documentation.title: Engineering review
documentation.summary: A portable independent review workflow with one shared Technical Standard (STD), a reusable reviewer role and source-bound report checks. AI judges defects; Python checks evidence consistency.
prerequisites: Python 3 standard library and a tool-enabled host that can read the selected source and write artifacts outside it.
A lead-supplied candidate scope and reviewer distinct from the implementer. Host permissions and model availability are configured separately.

quick_start.prompt: Review module.py against its stated behavior. Keep the target unchanged and return a source-bound report.
quick_start.expected_result: A structured report, capture/inspection artifacts and a mechanical validation receipt, with actual evidence limits.

scenarios.title: Review a bounded change
scenarios.prompt: Review parser.py and its selected caller against the supplied requirements before integration.
scenarios.expected_result: Supported actionable findings or a no-findings result with inspected scope and unrun checks.

scenarios.title: Review changed sources
scenarios.prompt: Follow up after the selected source changed. Preserve the previous report and review the current bytes.
scenarios.expected_result: A fresh capture and affected review; the old source-bound report is not reused as current approval.

verification.expected_result: Thirteen authored mechanical controls pass; this does not establish AI review quality or host behavior.

troubleshooting.problem: The report is refused after a source change.
troubleshooting.solution: Preserve the old artifacts, capture current selected bytes and review the affected change before validating again.

troubleshooting.problem: The host cannot expose its exact model identity.
troubleshooting.solution: Record the requested profile and keep observed_model null; do not infer provider identity or switch accounts.

documentation.support: Give the maintaining lead the exact package/source hashes, failed control or refusal and redacted evidence. Do not include credentials.

repository.text: The repository itself is the installable skill. The agent asset describes a role; host activation and enforcement require separate configuration.

testing.prepare: Use disposable independent source fixtures and keep evidence outside them. Real behavioral runs need a fresh performing context and captured tool trace.
acceptance_criteria: Mechanical contract controls pass on exact package bytes.
Required actual behavioral cases receive independent source-bound assessment; unrun hosts remain unverified.
improvement_steps: Locate a concrete failure, preserve its evidence and change only the responsible code or instruction.
Repeat affected controls and the same frozen behavioral task within the configured bounds.
